instruction: Candid fitness photograph, full shot, high-angle diagonal view of an indoor gym with wooden floor panels and black rubber mats. In the background, the woman in the black crop top (R1) performs a push-up with her hands on a green medicine ball, looking down. In the foreground, the woman in the blue tank top (R2) performs a push-up with her hands on a red medicine ball, looking forward. The two women are positioned diagonally from each other, executing synchronized exercises under bright overhead gym lighting.
